featured_reviews.review_text:
The EV charging station located at Worli BEST Bus Depot is a convenient option for electric vehicle users in the area. It is equipped with 2 fast chargers (60 kW each), making it suitable for relatively quick charging sessions.

The station is operated via the Jio-bp Pulse App, which is easy to use for locating the station, initiating charging, and making payments.

Charging cost is approximately ₹26 per kWh (excluding taxes), which is fairly standard for fast-charging infrastructure in Mumbai.

Pros:

Fast charging (60 kW chargers)
Reliable app-based operation
Good location within Worli area

Cons:

Only 2 chargers available (may lead to waiting during peak time)
Pricing slightly on the higher side after taxes

Overall: A reliable and efficient charging station for EV users in Worli, especially for quick top-ups.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your feedback, Usman. We understand the demand for Ola charging is increasing during peak hours. However, infrastructure expansion happens gradually based on usage and feasibility. Even for Ather, we initially started with a single charger and added more over time as demand grew.

We’ve taken the first step by providing an Ola charging facility, and we’re continuously evaluating expansion based on actual utilization. It’s unfortunately not practical to install multiple chargers immediately just for peak-hour demand.

We’d genuinely appreciate if you could reconsider the 1-star rating. Constructive feedback helps us improve, but low ratings for providing and expanding EV infrastructure can discourage businesses from investing further. Our goal is to support EV users in Mumbai, and we hope you’ll continue encouraging these efforts as we grow.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Review:

I had a really good experience with this EV charging station. What impressed me the most was that the charging started instantly without wasting even a minute. Unlike many other Tata Power chargers where there is often a delay in connecting or initiating the session, this one worked seamlessly and efficiently from the very beginning.

Another major advantage is the setup of the charging station itself. It is quite spacious, which makes maneuvering and parking the vehicle very convenient. There is enough room around the charging bays, so it doesn’t feel cramped even when multiple vehicles are present.

I also appreciated that the charging station is covered. This may seem like a small detail, but it makes a huge difference, especially during harsh weather conditions like Mumbai’s heat or monsoon rains. Being able to plug in and wait comfortably without worrying about direct sunlight or getting drenched is a big plus.

Overall, this charging station offers a smooth, hassle-free, and user-friendly charging experience. The instant charging initiation, spacious layout, and covered infrastructure make it stand out from many other charging points. I would definitely prefer using this station again and highly recommend it to fellow EV owners.
